register.title: Offer BCSentinel as a data-health service.
register.lead: Register your company for the partner programme. Each request is reviewed before partner access is activated.
points: Structured assessments, prioritized actions, and executive-ready reports.
Partner accounts and customer access remain technically and organizationally separate.
No automatic activation without reviewing the request.
register.consent: I agree that my information may be processed for partner onboarding and contact.
register.login: Already a partner? Go to login
register.missing: Please complete all required fields and confirm consent.
register.success: Thank you. Your partner request has been submitted.
register.failed: Registration could not be submitted. Please try again later.

login.title: Secure access to the BCSentinel partner portal.
login.lead: Log in to review your partner profile, referred tenants, and commission status.
points: Referrals are assigned to the partner account in the backend.
Partner access remains separate from customer access.
Support is available for inactive accounts or reset problems.
login.forgotLead: Enter your email to request a reset link.
login.register: No partner account yet? Become a partner
login.forgotMissing: Please enter a valid email address.
login.forgotSuccess: If the email is known, a reset link has been sent.
login.failed: Login failed. Check credentials or API availability.
login.inactive: The partner account is inactive. Please contact support.
login.success: Login successful. Redirecting to the partner portal …

reset.title: Set a new password.
reset.lead: Use the reset link you received and choose a new password with at least eight characters.
points: The reset token may expire or may already have been used.
Use a unique password for partner access.
After a successful reset you will be redirected to partner login.
reset.tokenMissing: The reset token is missing from the link.
reset.tooShort: The password must contain at least eight characters.
reset.success: Password changed successfully. Redirecting to login …
reset.failed: Reset failed. The link may be invalid or expired.
